narration: For three months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. For {ghost_ahead_months} months the ghost's money sat above yours. In month {crossover_month} it slipped below yours and stayed there. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
